title: Jordan–Schönflies theorem
abstract: Formalizes the Jordan curve theorem and the extension of every homeomorphism between Jordan curves to a plane homeomorphism.

informal.Schoenflies.jordan_schoenflies_of_homeom: Every homeomorphism between two Jordan curves in the plane extends to a self-homeomorphism of the plane.
informal.Schoenflies.jordan_schoenflies: A homeomorphism between Jordan curves extends to a global homeomorphism agreeing with it on the source curve.
informal.Schoenflies.forall_isSeparating_of_isJor: Every Jordan curve separates the plane into an inside and an outside region.
